title: Accelerating Computation of Steiner Trees on GPUs
gpu_scope: GPU-parallelized KMB 2-approximation algorithm for the classic (single-group-per-terminal) Steiner Tree Problem in Graphs.
notes: Regular Steiner tree is the special case of group Steiner tree where every group is a singleton; a reproducibility artifact is also archived at https://zenodo.org/records/4477087.
collection_variant_note: Ordinary terminal Steiner tree covers the singleton-group special case, not unrestricted group Steiner tree.
